criteria.assertion: Resolver event delivery must not use refresh tickers or periodic subscription teardown; historical catch-up is represented by EOSE while the live subscription stays open.
Resolver-owned relay setup queries NIP-11 metadata before connecting/subscribing and explicitly records unavailable metadata.
Endpoint events pass the shared inbound NIP-01 trust boundary before resolver-specific kind, author, d-tag, and content validation.
Resolver keeps replaceable latest-wins/tombstone semantics and handles auth-required CLOSED messages through NIP-42 retry when credentials are configured.
